item.title: Custodian arrested, found hiding in girls’ locker room during game at West Virginia high school: police
item.description: A custodian was discovered hiding in a girls’ locker room during a basketball game at Martinsburg High School. Law enforcement responded and 29 charges have been filed.

item.title: Man killed, woman critically injured after trash truck hit-and-run in Northwest DC
item.description: A man is dead and a woman remains in critical condition after being struck in Northwest D.C. Police say the driver has been identified and no charges have been filed.

item.title: Homicide at senior living facility in Montgomery County being investigated
item.description: A homicide investigation is underway after an 87-year-old man was found dead at a senior living facility in Montgomery County over the weekend.Police responded to the Cogir Potomac Senior Living facility in the 10800 block of Potomac Tennis Lane around 7:30 a.m. Saturday.They arrived to find an unresponsive 87-year-old man, who was pronounced dead at the scene.His death is being investigated as a homicide following an initial investigation at the scene.Police did not release any further details

item.title: House explosion in Kent County kills man as wife, children, grandchildren able to escape
item.description: A family is mourning the loss of a husband, father and grandfather after their family home exploded in Kent County this weekend.Emergency crews responded to reports of a house explosion on the 6900 block of Pentridge Court in Chestertown around 5:45 p.m. Saturday. They arrived to find the 5,000-square-foot home completely engulfed in flames.After a night-long search, the homeowner was found dead under multiple layers of debris. item.title: DHS shutdown looms as funding bill fails Senate vote
item.description: Funding for the Department of Homeland Security failed to advance in the Senate on Thursday, paving the way for a partial government shutdown this weekend.

item.title: Sterling house fire leaves home heavily damaged, owners displaced
